hideFromRecents.title: Hide from recent tasks
hideFromRecents.desc: Lock before hiding to avoid being cleared in one tap

syncChannel.title: Sync method
syncChannel.confirmationDescription: Devices can sync across networks without being connected to the same Wi-Fi.
syncChannel.confirmationCrossNetwork: It supports syncing even when devices are not on the same Wi-Fi network.
syncChannel.confirmationExperimental: This is an experimental feature and may be less stable than standard sync.
syncChannel.confirmationWarning: This is experimental and may be less reliable.
syncChannel.confirmationReversible: You can switch back to standard sync on the Devices tab at any time.

mobileDiagnostics.unavailable: Upload is unavailable in this build.
mobileDiagnostics.failed: Could not complete the diagnostic action.

clipboardSync.title: Clipboard sync

autoApply.title: Auto-write to clipboard
autoApply.descLan: When new content arrives from the server, write it to this device clipboard automatically
autoApply.descP2p: When new content arrives from paired devices, write it to this device clipboard automatically

autoPush.title: Auto-push clipboard
autoPush.descLan: When you copy or use a history item, send it to the current server automatically
autoPush.descP2p: When you copy content on this device, sync it to your paired devices automatically

clipboardSync.footer: These options control sync direction; Background settings control where it can run

summary.diagnostics: Record and export logs for bug reports
summary.theme: Light, dark or match the system

sync.footer: When Auto-write is on, new content from paired devices is written to this device clipboard immediately; when off, it is only highlighted on Home. Auto-push reads every copy, so set Clipboard access to Allow first or iOS will ask each time.

extensions.footer: The share extension lets you send items to Unic directly from the iOS share sheet in other apps.

analytics.consentDescription: Helps improve Unic without collecting clipboard contents or names
analytics.footer: App version, system, region, session, paired device count, and diagnostic records without contents or names may be sent. Turning this off stops collection and clears pending data.
analytics.resetMessage: This removes pending statistics and diagnostics and creates a new anonymous identity.

live.captureHint: On iOS, confirm before reading a detected clipboard change.
live.excludedHint: Separate custom tags with commas. Tagged items are kept during automatic cleanup.
live.sessionLogsSummary: ZIP bundle with redacted Engine logs and manifest, without clipboard contents
live.sessionLogsFooter: Exports a ZIP diagnostic bundle containing retained redacted Engine logs, runtime state, and a checksum manifest. Clipboard contents and credentials are never included.
